meaning:
A man living at the time of Divided Monarchy, first mentioned at 1Ki.16.21;
son of: Ginath (H1527)
§ Tibni = "intelligent"
contender for the throne of the northern kingdom of Israel after the death of Zimri; fought for 4 years with the rival faction whose leader was Omri; died after 4 years leaving the throne to Omri

elsewhere.note: Then the people of Israel were divided into two parts: half of the people followed Tibni the son of Ginath, to make him king; and half followed Omri.
